title: Cascade gate: claim refuses unmet depends_on
subject: cascade-gate
ratio: The cascade gate is mechanical, not advisory: blackboard.py claim refuses any task whose depends_on tasks are not all done. No agent may begin a dependent task before its dependencies verdict done; an agent needing a gated task works the unblocked frontier instead. There is no sanctioned bypass verb.
